modules.text:
Syntona has modules that can be connected together.
Modules havaee input and output jacks where connections are made.
This patch has a fader and show mdule. TryClick in the middle of the knob and move it up and down. The knob sends messages with a number to the show module whicvh displays the number.

There is also a fader and a show module that are not connected. Click on the output jack of the knob and drag a line over to the input jack of the show dulemodule and then release the mouse. Keep trying until you are able to connect them.
